episodes.title: Alone
episodes.summary: Ish, a solitary young geologist, barely survives a snake bite; after he wakes from a coma, he drives to the nearest town only to find dead bodies; he searches for survivors, from San Francisco to Las Vegas.

episodes.title: The Space Between
episodes.summary: Ish finds a survivor, EMMA. There's a spark. Is it real, or are they just the last two people on earth? Nature is unrelenting. RATS plague San Lupo. Ish dreams of rebuilding civilization, but can they even survive extinction?

episodes.title: World Without End
episodes.summary: New survivors appear but Ish doesn't trust them, Emma invites them in; a bad storm slams San Lupo.

episodes.title: Predators
episodes.summary: A drought hits San Lupo; a nomadic group arrives that knows how to find water and want to trade; Ish has his doubts, but chooses to accept help.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.summary: Ish catches Charlie assaulting Evie so San Lupo must decide how to punish evil; the virus returns and Joey falls ill; Ish feels humanity's future hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: Forever Is Tomorrow Is Today
episodes.summary: San Lupo fights for survival against the virus; Ish realizes the answers to humanity's future may not be in his books and finds Joey's secret project.
